english.note: Use this for the whole high-heeled shoe, rather than just the heel part of a shoe.

exampleSentences.english: I have to wear a shoe with a high heel at tomorrow’s wedding banquet.
exampleSentences.traditional: 聽日婚宴，我要着高踭鞋。
